# Bankers By Day

> Comprehensive career guides and educational resources for finance professionals across investment banking, capital markets, private equity, and related fields.

Bankers By Day provides in-depth career guidance covering major finance disciplines including investment banking, M&A, debt and equity capital markets, leveraged finance, and alternative asset management. The site serves as a resource for professionals navigating finance career paths and understanding key roles in the financial services industry.

## Key Topics

- Investment Banking
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Debt Capital Markets
- Equity Capital Markets
- Leveraged Finance
- Private Equity
- Sales & Trading
- Asset Management
- Portfolio Management
- Venture Capital
- Hedge Funds
- Project Finance
- Financial Engineering
- Equity Research
- Career Paths

## Finance Career Guides

- [Finance Career Guides](https://www.bankersbyday.com/finance-career-guides): Career guides covering investment banking, M&A, capital markets, and finance roles
